description: Scrape 2-20 URLs in parallel and get every result back in one synchronous call, no polling required. Use when a normal fetch returns 403/429, a bot-protection challenge page, a CAPTCHA, or an empty JavaScript shell. Failed URLs report their error; successful ones return content. For 20+ URLs use alterlab_batch.

render_js.description: Render JavaScript with a headless browser. Default: false.

use_proxy.description: Route through a premium proxy. Default: false.

name: alterlab_batch_scrape
title: Scrape Multiple URLs
